company.name: MarqVision
company.shortDescription: MarqVision is an AI Services Platform for Global Brands. We provide brand protection, brand establishment and brand intelligence services.
company.description: MarqVision is an AI-powered brand protection platform that helps companies detect and remove counterfeit products from online marketplaces. It assists brands in detecting and removing infringing listings from global online marketplaces infiltrated by counterfeiters using its machine learning technology. Its technology also helps clients to efficiently protect their sales and reputation from intellectual property infringement. It serves industries including fashion, luxury goods, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics.
